reproduce: scripts/bench-tscircuit.sh <samples> [categories...] ; MR_SOLVE_LAYERS=N for the layer budget
notes: 1-layer column is the byte-identical single-layer baseline; 2-layer is the default solve budget (MR_SOLVE_LAYERS=2).
traces lifts 52% -> 99% from the 2nd layer (crossing-bound boards).

keyboards does not lift (large multi-net boards fail on full-connectivity, not crossing-overlap); sampled at 10 because the 48-70-net instances are legalization-bound and mostly unroutable at this resolution.
keyboards/traces solve speed: exhaustive-permutation legalization capped at n_groups<=5 (~18x on 6-7 group boards, identical completion); negotiation parallelized for n_nets>16.
